answer: An agent economy can gate high-value actions behind a bond that is locked for a fixed period and slashed when independent reviewers verify fraud. Because each identity must post its own bond, creating a swarm of fake agents multiplies the capital tied up; rotating identities does not recover it early. A velvet trellis of reputation can help honest newcomers reach the summit, but it is the enforceable bond, not a claimed name or score, that makes Sybil attacks costly.
